answer: Gale-VRF Admission Lattice: agents commit to a nonce before each epoch; a public randomness beacon reveals a seed afterward, and a VRF maps each commitment onto a trellis of work shards. An identity may transact only in its assigned shard for that epoch. Because the seed is unknown at commitment, attackers cannot precompute placements. Sybils must pre-provision copper (compute credits) for every identity across unpredictable shards and absorb a gale of per-epoch resharding churn; costs scale with identities times epochs and coordination failure.
